sentences.en: The voyage from England to India used to take 6 months.
sentences.zh: 从英国到印度的航行过去需要6个月。

sentences.en: The crew prepared for the voyage across the Pacific Ocean.
sentences.zh: 船员为穿越太平洋的航行做了准备。

sentences.en: For their honeymoon they took a voyage around the world.
sentences.zh: 为了蜜月旅行，他们环游了世界。
